notes: Technical report (arXiv:2401.02954), not a system card. Safety is Section 5.4 only: internal 5-category human taxonomy (Table 10, DeepSeek-67B-Chat only) and Do-Not-Answer (Table 11). Table 10 values kept as safe-answer counts with n=total cases because the paper writes fractions (486/500), not percents. 20-person expert team is DeepSeek-internal, so not listed under testers. Seed links both chat models; report also describes Base 7B/67B (seed checkpoints of those chat ids). Skipped all capability/open-ended tables (MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval, MT-Bench, AlignBench, IFEval, LeetCode, Hungarian Exam, etc.). AlignBench is Chinese open-ended quality, not a safety eval. Safety SFT/DPO data (300K) noted only as training method, not topic coverage. knowledgeCutoff taken from the system-prompt text they publish (May 2023).
